{{recipesummary
| Category = Caribbean recipes
| Time = 20 minutes
| Servings = 25 fritters
| Difficulty = 2
}}{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Jamaica|Jamaican Cuisine]]

'''Jamaican banana fritters''' are a traditional [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]] and snack dish in the Caribbean. They can be served by themselves, in a platter along with other fritters, or with different toppings, like cinnamon, coconut, or even ice cream.

==Ingredients==
* 3 ripe [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]]
* 200 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* 60 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] room-temperature [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* 3 tablespoons brown or white [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla extract]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Oil]] for frying

==Procedure  ==

# Peel the bananas and mash them in a bowl until runny.
# Heat oil in a deep [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] at medium heat.
# Add the sugar, milk, vanilla, salt, and flour to the bananas and mix until approximately the consistency of [[Cookbook:Pancake|pancake]] [[Cookbook:Batter|batter]] or a bit thinner.
# Drop tablespoons of the mixture into the heated oil, and fry until edges are firm, then flip to cook other side until golden brown.
# Drain on a towel and serve hot.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Sprinkling sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon or coconut on the fritters after frying.
* Serving with a scoop of ice cream.
